page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at top left. A two-line italic title stands above the main paragraph. The body contains one long paragraph, a Greek quotation, and a final paragraph. No marginal notes, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Rhodum prius liberam fuisse, sed sub Vespasiano imperatore cum cæteris insulis provinciæ conditionem accepisse.

head.i: Forma reipublicæ Rhodiorum post fractas Lacedæmoniorum vires per Thebanos.

main_text.p: AD reipublicæ formam, unde digressus sum longiuscule, dum cæterarum rerum seriem intentius persequor, nunc revertor. Quin ad primitivum statum reipublicæ redierint Rhodii suo arbitrio redditi, nec Laconico nec Attico fœderi illigati amplius, quod infracta à Thebanis Lacedæmoniorum potentia accidisse existimo, nulla me ratio cogit dubitare. Nam de primorum potestate Strabonis tempore adhuc reliqua testantur clara ejusdem auctoris verba libro xiiii[?], quæ sic habent:

p.i: δημοκρατούμενοι[?] δ' ἐστὶν οἱ Ῥόδιοι, καίπερ[?] ἢ δημοκρατούμενοι[?], σωιζειν[?] δ' ὅμως βουλόμενοι τὰ ἴδια ἑαυτῶν πολιτεύεσθαι[?].

main_text.p: Duo pariter dicit, & populi cultores esse Rhodios, idque operam dare, ut sustententur etiam egeni, & tamen à populo eos non regi: id est, rempublicam eorum in potestate populi non esse. Quod verum esse non poterat, nisi primores ad clavum tunc sedif-sent.

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Greek passage is partly doubtful: the scan is faint in the first words and in "σωιζειν", "καίπερ" and the final word, marked [?]. Roman numeral "xiiii" marked [?] (could be xiiii or xiii). Line-end hyphen "sedif-sent" kept as printed. Faint marks in the bottom left corner ("1888"-like figures) and the left margin shadows (show-through or stamps from other pages) are not printed text on this page and are omitted.
